subject: AWS private listing — request for special marketplace terms & rev-share
messages:
From: Tariq Hassan <tariq.hassan@veloventures.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@veloventures.com>, AWS Marketplace PM <pm-aws@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood private offer — proposed marketplace terms

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We've run this through product and procurement and AWS is willing to list us on a private offer, but the marketplace-only economics need one-off alignment to make the deal work on our end. Attached is the term proposal from our side (VV_AWS_Private_Offer_Proposal.pdf). Key ask highlights: 

- 35% marketplace rev-share to the reseller/partner line item for the first 12 months (AWS has proposed this structure)
- Net60 payment terms to align with our enterprise billing cadence
- 25% discount off Redwood list price for initial 12 months, then standard renewal pricing
- Co-marketing credits and a two-quarter onboarding success check-in

We understand these deviate from standard Redwood marketplace defaults (typically lower rev-share caps and Net30). This is a strategic account for us in retail; annual committed spend is expected to be $1.9M with an initial 12-month commitment. Can your team confirm whether Redwood can accept these marketplace economics or if we need an executive exception?

Appreciate a quick call if helpful — Tariq
Tariq Hassan
Head of Platform Partnerships
VeloVentures
+t: 415-555-0198
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Tariq Hassan <tariq.hassan@veloventures.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@veloventures.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood private offer — proposed marketplace terms

Tariq — thanks for the note and the attachment. I ran preliminary numbers with a pricing model and the asks you listed would compress our net revenue materially at launch, but this is a high-visibility, high-growth retail customer and opening the AWS private listing here gives us strategic leverage in the sector.

Short version: we need an internal deviation approval on the marketplace rev-share (35% vs our routed cap) and extended payment terms (Net60). I'll escalate to Deal Desk + Sales Ops for exec signoff today.

I attached a one-page internal summary of the financial impact (RDW_internal_term_summary.xlsx) and my recommendation (propose approving a 30% rev-share cap + Net45 vs the full ask) as a compromise to protect our unit economics while keeping the customer moving.

I'll follow up once I have internal signoff.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood private offer — proposed marketplace terms (escalation + exec signoff request)

Folks — forwarding VeloVentures' request and my recommendation. TL;DR: strategic retail account; asks are 35% marketplace rev-share (AWS), Net60, 25% discount for 12 months; projected ARR ~1.9M first year.

Why I recommend approval (brief):
- High reference value in retail vertical; AWS channel lead has signaled we should be flexible to win
- Accelerates customer to production on our platform (reduces time-to-value)
- They will commit to a 12-month minimum and co-marketing window if we accept adjusted economics

Impact if we approve as asked: ~18% reduction in first-year net revenue vs standard listing (see attachment). My preferred compromise: approve a 30% rev-share cap, Net45 payment terms, and cap the 25% discount to 9 months, with a mandatory renewal minimum and a co-marketing deliverable. This preserves runway while showing flexibility.

Attachments: RDW_internal_term_summary.xlsx, redline_terms_for_exec.docx

Request: need an exec/Deal Desk signoff (marissa/karthik) and Finance confirmation (neha) on Net45/Net60 exposure. If you approve, I'll send the formal private offer to AWS PM and procurement.

Thanks — Logan

[original message attached above]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 13:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood private offer — proposed marketplace terms (escalation + exec signoff request)

Logan — thanks for the summary and the model. I reviewed the attachments and ran the numbers for the commission and marketplace payouts. A few points from Deal Desk: 

1) Full approval for 35% rev-share to stand as-is will set an unfavorable precedent for marketplace exceptions. We should avoid a hard precedent without a documented playbook.
2) If we're approving any >30% marketplace rev-share, it should be tied to measurable adoption milestones and an irrevocable renewal trigger (e.g., 12-month commit with minimum attested consumption).
3) Net60 is higher risk for Finance; Net45 is a reasonable middle ground. Neha, any comments on credit/collections exposure?

Proposed formal exception we can take to Marissa for signoff: 
- Approve 30% marketplace rev-share for months 0–9, reverting to standard rate thereafter
- Approve Net45 payment terms for the first year only, review at renewal
- Approve a cap on the initial 25% discount to 9 months and require a 12-month minimum committed spend clause in the private offer
- Mandatory co-marketing deliverable (joint case study or AWS webinar) tied to a 6-month success milestone

I'll prepare an internal redline and short rationale memo. If Marissa signs off, Legal will need to run the final redline before we submit to AWS.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Jul 2025 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood private offer — proposed marketplace terms (escalation + exec signoff request)

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround and the detailed analysis. I agree with Karthik's framing and will approve an exception on the following limited terms: 

1) Approve marketplace rev-share at 30% for months 0–9; revert to standard marketplace rev-share thereafter.
2) Approve Net45 payment terms for the initial 12-month term only, subject to credit checks and a signed 12-month minimum committed spend clause.
3) Approve discount limited to 25% for 9 months only; after month 9 pricing returns to our standard list unless renewed under new terms.
4) Require co-marketing deliverable: joint case study or AWS webinar within 6 months; failure to meet the milestone will trigger a review and potential clawback clause defined by Legal.

I want Legal to run the redline and confirm language for the clawback and renewal triggers before we send to AWS PM. Karthik — please prepare the final exception memo and send to Legal. Logan — once Legal signs off, please notify Tariq and AWS PM and proceed with the private offer creation.

Discretionary note: this is an exception tied to strategic GTM value. We should not bake this into a global policy without a separate playbook.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
